articles.title: ClaimsBridge Secures Strategic Investment And Acquires DialysisPPO To Expand Cost Containment Capabilities
articles.summary: ClaimsBridge has secured a strategic investment and acquired DialysisPPO to broaden its healthcare cost management platform and tackle specialized high-cost claims. This expansion matters because dialysis represents one of the most significant cost drivers for self-funded employers managing employee health benefits. For organizations like RxBenefits, this move signals a broader industry trend toward integrating specialized point solutions to curb escalating outlays in self-funded employer plans.
